decisions.reason: As a training service closely tied to the installed base and existing capabilities, it likely meets modest aspiration levels through customer support and cross-selling even if direct standalone returns are limited.

This accessory fits the firm's modular engineering logic and core machines, so unless demand clearly fell short of aspiration it would usually be retained because it leverages existing products and service channels.

Because it is distant from the firm's established offer and likely more uncertain in demand and capability fit, a performance shortfall would trigger problemistic search and reallocation toward the stronger core business.

A high-speed CNC milling machine is very close to the firm's core business and was launched as a multi-model line, making it likely to be kept unless results were far below aspiration for an extended period.

The automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm's existing equipment platform and customer needs, so organisational slack and strong complementarities make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
